bagPolicy.summary: Bags are allowed at Blues Alley, but small bags are preferred.
bagPolicy.quote: Bags are permitted but small bags are preferred.

parking.summary: Paid parking is available at Georgetown Park, 1092 Wisconsin Ave NW.
parking.quote: Paid parking available at Georgetown Park 1092 Wisconsin Ave NW, Washington DC, 20007.

rideshare.summary: Concerto couldn't find a rideshare pickup zone published by Blues Alley. Set your pickup to the venue's address. After the show, use any signed pickup area, or walk a block or two from the main exit before you request a ride so your driver can reach you.

concessions.summary: Blues Alley has a per-person food or beverage minimum, which is charged separately from your ticket.
concessions.quote: There is a $15 food or beverage minimum per person.

accessibility.summary: The seating and stage are on street level and accessible. Restrooms are on the second floor and can only be reached by stairs. If you use a wheelchair, have a service animal or need other help, call the club before you arrive.
accessibility.quote: The performance area (seating and stage) are accessible and on street level.

reEntry.summary: Blues Alley hasn't published re-entry details on its official site. Check your event page or contact the venue before you go.

ticketPickup.summary: The box office is open from 12pm to 6pm for phone and in-person ticket sales. Tickets bought through third-party websites are not accepted. Ages 10 and up are admitted, and minors must be with an adult.
ticketPickup.quote: The Box Office is open during the day from 12pm-6pm to purchase tickets over the phone or in person.

gates.summary: Doors open about an hour before the early show, typically 6pm Monday through Saturday and 4:30pm on Sundays. Seating is general admission, first come first served, so arriving earlier gets you more choice of seats.
gates.quote: Seating is general admission, first come first serve.
